questions.question: What is this platform?
questions.answer: This is a website creation platform that allows you to quickly build a professional business website using ready-made templates, without any programming knowledge.

questions.question: Do I need programming skills?
questions.answer: No. All templates are ready to use, and website management is done through a simple admin panel.

questions.question: How can I choose a template?
questions.answer: You can browse the list of templates, choose a design that fits your business type, and proceed with the purchase or subscription.

questions.question: What is included in the subscription plans?
questions.answer: Plans may include hosting, an admin system, technical support, and security updates.

questions.question: Can I buy a website without a subscription?
questions.answer: Yes. You can make a one-time purchase without monthly or yearly payments and receive a ready-made website with an admin system.

questions.question: When will I receive the website after purchase?
questions.answer: In most cases, the website is delivered immediately or within a very short time through an automated system.

questions.question: Can I manage the website myself?
questions.answer: Yes. Through the admin panel, you can edit texts, images, and contact details.

questions.question: Is technical support available?
questions.answer: Yes. Technical support is provided according to the plan you choose.

questions.question: Can I connect my own domain?
questions.answer: Yes. You can connect your own domain (for example, mybusiness.com).

questions.question: Are the websites responsive?
questions.answer: Yes. All templates are fully responsive and work properly on mobile phones, tablets, and desktop computers.
